verdict.rationale: Isaac covers the configuration side of robot bring-up. It imports robot descriptions from URDF, MJCF, Onshape CAD or USD and offers robot tuning tools. Isaac Lab says you can add your own robots, and ROS 2 bridging plus Isaac ROS packages can deploy to Jetson. However, this is mostly simulation-side setup rather than real hardware drivers, and nothing documents getting to first motion on a physical robot in hours. Missing for 10: hardware driver/bring-up tooling for physical robots, a documented first-motion workflow on real hardware, and independent or hands-on evidence of hours-scale bring-up times.
